correctness.rationale: For every n>=3, apply the published Boolean-complex wedge theorem to prove integral homology freeness and concentration. The signed Lefschetz alternating fixed-cell formula follows from increasing-vertex cellular orientations. Rotation orbits reduce to cycle chromatic-polynomial evaluation at q=-1; direct edge cases d=1,2 are handled. Reflections reduce to three explicit quotient path sizes and path-polynomial recurrence. All 2n elements are covered with boundary cases; independent exhaustive orientation and exact-chain verifiers pass for their stated finite ranges.

originality.rationale: The precise claim is the full rational dihedral character on top cycle-Boolean-complex homology, not the preexisting homotopy type or top Betti number. Ragnarsson–Tenner 2008/2011 and Jonsson–Welker 2007 were inspected for statement-level implication, including the primary cycle table, mod-two bases, commutation-class orientation lemma and shellability results. None supplies signed rotation/reflection character values. Targeted published-record searches also located no statement dominating the formula. A published or unindexed equivalent is still possible.
residual_risks: An equivalent result may be present in unindexed or inaccessible literature; none was found by the bounded searches.

value.rationale: The cycle C_n is a natural affine-A Coxeter graph with full dihedral symmetry. Prior work calculates only wedge count L_n-2 and mod-two bases; the rational character on all rotations and the parity-distinguished reflection axes is a motivated infinite-family topological representation invariant that cannot be derived from Betti numbers and has potential applications to equivariant graph complexes.
